items.text: Lucy is a freelance designer. Today she's closing a new project on a video call. RockSign is listening.
Hi Mark! Thanks for jumping on. Quick heads-up: I use RockSign, so this call is recorded, and you'll get the agreement to sign when we hang up. Is that okay?
Sure, that works for me.
Great. So, what do you need?
We're launching a new product next month. We need our landing page redesigned, plus three social media pieces for the launch.

detect.label: Deliverables
detect.value: Landing page redesign + 3 social media pieces

items.text: Got it. The landing page plus three social pieces. When do you need them?
Ideally by Friday, October 23rd.
That works. For that scope, my fee is $1,200.
items.say: That works. For that scope, my fee is twelve hundred dollars.

items.text: $1,200 is fine. How do you want to get paid?
items.say: Twelve hundred is fine. How do you want to get paid?

items.text: 50% upfront, and the other 50% when I deliver the final files.
items.say: Fifty percent upfront, and the other fifty when I deliver the final files.

items.text: Deal. What about changes? Our CEO always has opinions.
I include two rounds of revisions. Anything beyond that is $60 an hour.
items.say: I include two rounds of revisions. Anything beyond that is sixty dollars an hour.

items.text: Fair enough. Oh, and we'll need the source files too. The Figma file and all the exports.
Of course. You'll get the Figma file and every exported asset.

detect.label: Handoff
detect.value: Figma source file + all exported assets

items.text: Perfect. Let's do it.
Awesome. I'll start on Monday, October 5th. Talk soon!
items.say: Awesome. I'll start on Monday, October fifth. Talk soon!

items.text: The moment the call ends, RockSign turns the conversation into a draft agreement, and sends it to everyone who was on the call.
Mark gets it seconds later. No account, no app to install.
Every clause links to the exact moment it was agreed. Not sure about the payment terms? Just listen.
One tap to sign. Now both sides share the same record of the deal.
RockSign. What's said, gets signed.
